assist.strategyChange: Changed from issuer-results/backlog comparison to direct SEC contractual-commitment and customer-concentration evidence after Scout changed the input signature.

claims.claim: Customer concentration is a directly observed execution risk: Microvast disclosed that its five largest customers represented 58.4% of 2025 revenue, increasing sensitivity to customer-specific platform timing, purchasing decisions and demand changes.

Framework-agreement scale should not be treated as contracted utilization: Microvast states that long-term supply/framework agreements typically do not impose minimum purchase obligations and that specific purchase orders constitute contractual commitments.

The concentration and contract-structure evidence strengthens the causal interpretation of the already-observed 2026 utilization weakness: incremental capacity economics depend on actual customer purchase orders and platform ramps, not framework agreements or installed capacity alone.

risks: A concentrated customer base can amplify utilization volatility when a major platform ramp slips or purchasing changes.
Framework agreements without minimum purchase obligations can create apparent demand visibility that does not guarantee absorption of incremental capacity.
contradictions: Localized capacity expansion can improve supply resilience, while the disclosed contract structure and customer concentration mean capacity absorption remains dependent on actual purchase orders and customer ramps.
unknowns: Current purchase-order coverage for incremental Clarksville and Huzhou capacity.
Current revenue concentration after 2025 and the share of incremental capacity tied to the largest customers.
falsifiers: Primary evidence of diversified customer concentration plus binding purchase-order coverage sufficient to absorb incremental capacity would materially weaken this concentration/utilization risk.
Sustained utilization and margin recovery despite customer timing variability would weaken the causal importance of the disclosed concentration and framework structure.
authorityGuardrail: This artifact supplies bounded risk evidence only and does not set Alpha numeric risk, score, canonical rank, tick, membership or Chief disposition.
